# Inventory Report

The operations team compared warehouse counts across two quarters and flagged every mismatch for review before the numbers were approved for the final report.

| Item | Q1 | Q2 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bolts | 120 | 132 |
| Nuts | 88 | 91 | 77 |
| Screws | 240 | 228 |

The extra cell in the second data row makes the column mapping ambiguous, so the document must be reviewed instead of silently dropping the value.
